title: Find k closest values
summary: A sorted list is used to find the k values nearest to a target. Return those values in ascending order; when distances tie, prefer the smaller value. The input contains distinct values.
requirements: Input is sorted in ascending order.
When distances tie, prefer the smaller value.
Return [] if k is outside 0..array length.
hints: The answer is a contiguous k-length window.
Binary search the starting index, comparing the excluded values at both ends.
